title: Doctor Schedule Setup
description: Weekly consultation shifts per doctor for the current branch. Published shifts define the bookable appointment slots.

hints.publish: Only published shifts appear as bookable slots in appointment booking.
hints.noSlots: This shift produces no bookable slots. Reduce the minutes per patient.
hints.branchScope: Shifts are managed for your current working branch only.
hints.doctorImmutable: Doctor cannot be changed after schedule creation. Retire this schedule and create a new one.

messages.empty: No consultation shift configured yet for this branch.
messages.confirmDeactivate: Retire this shift? It will no longer offer bookable slots.
messages.confirmUnpublish: Unpublish this shift? New bookings will be blocked for its slots.

errors.generic: The shift could not be saved.
errors.DOCTOR_SCHEDULE_BRANCH_REQUIRED: A valid working branch is required.
errors.DOCTOR_SCHEDULE_BRANCH_ACCESS_DENIED: This shift belongs to another branch.
errors.DOCTOR_SCHEDULE_DOCTOR_NOT_AT_BRANCH: This doctor is not assigned to the current branch.
errors.DOCTOR_SCHEDULE_INVALID_DAY: Select a valid day of the week.
errors.DOCTOR_SCHEDULE_INVALID_RANGE: Shift end must be later than shift start.
errors.DOCTOR_SCHEDULE_INVALID_SLOT_DURATION: Minutes per patient must fit inside the shift.
errors.DOCTOR_SCHEDULE_OVERLAP: This shift overlaps another shift for the same doctor and day.
errors.DOCTOR_SCHEDULE_DUPLICATE: A shift already starts at this time for the same doctor and day.
errors.DOCTOR_SCHEDULE_HAS_BOOKINGS: Upcoming appointments still use this shift. Cancel or complete them first.
errors.DOCTOR_SCHEDULE_STALE: This shift was changed by someone else. Refresh and try again.
errors.DOCTOR_SCHEDULE_DOCTOR_IMMUTABLE: Doctor cannot be changed after schedule creation. Retire this schedule and create a new one.
